title: PMBrc / SETU performance evaluation
description: Independent PMBrc / SETU study reporting 94.5% recovery and comparable chromatographic performance for the evaluated isocratic method.
sourcePages: Study design pp. 5–6; recovery p. 7; performance pp. 8–9; report example p. 11.
caveats: Two 96-injection sequences using paracetamol and ibuprofen; recovered mobile phase from the first sequence was reused in the second.
Volumes registered by ReSolve. LC/MS detection limits and formal equivalence margins are not stated in the report.

title: PMBrc evaluation: results and boundaries
description: A concise two-page account of recovery, chromatographic response and the independent study results.
sourcePages: 2 pages, based on report BM22072026 dated 22 July 2026.
caveats: The all-to-waste comparison is calculated from detector throughput. Preparation, wash and flush solvents are outside that comparison.

title: ReSolve user manual — Rev 1.0
description: The complete reference for ReSolve operation, peak detection, diversion timing and reporting workflows.
sourcePages: Mechanism pp. 10–13; reporting and configuration pp. 28–37; 38 pages total.

title: ReSolve product brochure — Rev 2
description: Antech’s original product overview: selective recovery, laboratory benefits, operating concept and technical specifications.
sourcePages: 4 pages; operating concept p. 2; specifications p. 4.
caveats: Original Rev 2 product collateral. The final PMBrc report supplies the study-specific performance figures.

title: Regulatory and sustainability white paper
description: Antech’s business and sustainability case for mobile-phase recovery, with an evidence summary and transparent savings calculations.
sourcePages: Evidence p. 3; proposed qualification framework p. 4; savings boundaries p. 5; 6 pages total.
caveats: September 2026 edition. External references retain their original publication status.
The paper separates recovered throughput, fresh-solvent purchasing and net operating benefit.

title: Illustrative injection report
description: An original example showing method settings, waste-event windows, collected volumes and the chromatogram together.
sourcePages: 1 page; date shown is the example injection date.
caveats: Illustrative ABC Pharma report dated 8 January 2025; the displayed 80% recovery belongs to this example.
